segments: Oh, ye men.
It is not the great king, nor the
multitude of men, neither is it wine
that excelleth.
Who is it then that ruleth them, or hath
the lordship over them?
Are they not women?
Yea, and if men have gathered
together gold and silver or any other
goodly thing,
do they not love a woman  which
is comely in favor and beauty?
These also make garments
for men. These bring glory unto men.
Buy your vineyard or the vegetable or if
you prefer, I'll give you a better
vineyard in exchange. Lord forbid it.
I'm not allowed to give up the vineyard.
The Lord forbid it.  Why is your
spirit so sad that you will not eat?
Because of Naboth the Jezreelite who
refused to give me his vineyard. And
without women cannot men be.
>> What if I took the fruit of it?
You shall
not die.
>> [screaming]
>> What do you think of this?
Yea, and if men  have gathered
together gold and silver or any other
goodly thing,
do they not love a woman which is comely
in favor and beauty?
You never handle anything. I have to do
everything  in this house while
you just sit there. You are not a man.
You are a liability.
I I for this family. I pay every bill in
here. I show up every single day and it
is never enough for you. NEVER. WHAT
ELSE DO YOU WANT FROM ME?
>> Showing up is the minimum. That is not
something to be celebrated. You want a
trophy for doing what you are supposed
to do? And letting all those things go,
do they not gape? And even with
open mouth, fix their eyes fast on her.
>> Must be nice to have time for everybody
else.
>> And have not all men more desire unto
her than unto silver or gold or any
goodly thing whatsoever.
